propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER criterion decomp-shape must be added to detect layer-cake decomposition patterns where children are partitioned by architectural layer instead of vertical slices.
The criterion must identify consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge smell where a child names/consumes an artifact a sibling produces but has no ordering dependency between them.

The decomp-shape criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA list, and routed through pass1_container fan-out with advisory posture.

The criterion must pass deterministic unit tests validating registration invariants, routing shape, prompt contract, and eval_solver container-arm extension for running container criteria over fixtures with children.
Bounded sanity evaluation with 4 hand-authored fixtures must confirm the criterion fires on layer-cake and consumed-artifact positives and is clean on vertical-slice and ordered negatives.
Blocking promotion is deferred until E6 order-stability (fleiss_kappa) clears the 0.6 floor and effectiveness metrics demonstrate high detection_proxy with low false-positive rate.
